      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Application, ApplicationNote, EmailLog, Document\nfrom schemas import WithdrawApplicationResponse, WithdrawApplicationRequest\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Applications\"])\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/applications/{application_number}/withdraw\",\n    operation_id=\"withdraw_application\",\n    response_model=WithdrawApplicationResponse,\n)\nasync def withdraw_application(\n    application_number: str,\n    payload: WithdrawApplicationRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n    current_user_id: int = 1,  # Simulated current user ID\n):\n    # Find the application by application_number\n    application = db.query(Application).filter(Application.application_number == application_number).first()\n    if not application:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Application not found\")\n\n    # Update application status to Withdrawn\n    old_status = application.status\n    application.status = \"Withdrawn\"\n    application.updated_at = datetime.utcnow()\n\n    # Add internal note\n    note = ApplicationNote(\n        application_id=application.id,\n        author_user_id=current_user_id,\n        note=payload.note,\n        is_internal=True,\n    )\n    db.add(note)\n    db.flush()  # Get the note ID before committing\n\n    # Log email (simulated)\n    applicant = db.query(Application.applicant_id).filter(Application.id == application.id).first()\n    applicant_email = db.query(Applicant.email).filter(Applicant.id == applicant.applicant_id).first()\n    email_log = EmailLog(\n        application_id=application.id,\n        recipient_email=applicant_email.email,\n        subject=\"Application Withdrawn - APP-3172\",\n        body=\"Your application has been withdrawn.\",\n        template_name=\"withdrawal_confirmation\",\n        sent_by_user_id=current_user_id,\n        sent_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n        status=\"Sent\",\n    )\n    db.add(email_log)\n    db.flush()  # Get the email log ID before committing\n\n    # Commit all changes\n    db.commit()\n\n    return WithdrawApplicationResponse(\n        application_id=application.id,\n        application_number=application.application_number,\n        new_status=application.status,\n        note_id=note.id,\n        email_log_id=email_log.id,\n    )"

      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import Application, ApplicationNote\nfrom schemas import ApplicationNoteOut, ApplicationNoteIn\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"ApplicationNotes\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\n    \"/api/applications/{application_number}/notes\",\n    operation_id=\"add_application_note\",\n    response_model=ApplicationNoteOut,\n)\nasync def add_application_note(\n    application_number: str,\n    payload: ApplicationNoteIn,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db),\n    current_user_id: int = 1,  # Simulated current user ID\n):\n    # Find the application by application_number\n    application = db.query(Application).filter(Application.application_number == application_number).first()\n    if not application:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Application not found\")\n\n    # Create new note\n    note = ApplicationNote(\n        application_id=application.id,\n        author_user_id=current_user_id,\n        note=payload.note,\n        is_internal=payload.is_internal,\n    )\n    db.add(note)\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(note)\n\n    return ApplicationNoteOut(\n        id=note.id,\n        application_id=note.application_id,\n        author_user_id=note.author_user_id,\n        note=note.note,\n        is_internal=note.is_internal,\n        created_at=note.created_at,\n        updated_at=note.updated_at,\n    )"
